Imported Drum and Stack DSP, envelope helpers, lookup-table generators and
tools/copingSynth/generate_wavetables.py. No audio samples or GM bank included.

NullPerator adaptations: native fixed-point include; natural voice alignment;
correct frequency multiply/shift and signed lookup addressing; terminating
envelopes; explicit idle silence; bipolar drum output; functioning brightness
mip selection; retrigger handling; removal of logging from the audio path.

Wave tables: regenerate with
python3 tools/copingSynth/generate_wavetables.py sources/Externals/copingSynth/StackInstrument/StackWavetables.generated.h
